description: Land Cover Classification in Harare, Zimbabwe is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Climate, Physical features", published or maintained by World Bank Group. These raster files show the land cover classification around Harare in 2006 and 2010. The classification results were based on Spot 5 imagery. Coverage: Zimbabwe. It has 3 files in ZIP. The portal files it under Climate, Physical features. The portal gives 2020 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
